episode_title: Communication First: How a CHRO Leads Through AI and Organizational Change

real_qa.q: How should a CHRO prioritize communication strategy when implementing AI and organizational change?
real_qa.r: Prioritize communication to employees above all else. Regardless of how fast you're going with AI or not, every company should have great communications. People still have options and if you don't communicate correctly what's happening and why, all your prioritization goes out the window and you're just creating noise. The number one thing every CHRO should focus on right now is ensuring a good message and clear why for organizational decisions.

real_qa.q: What is Revacore's approach to job description redesign and automation with Claude AI?
real_qa.r: Revacore is scraping every single job description and asking leaders first what can be automated, then putting it through Claude to identify automation opportunities. A job description in May 2026 is completely different from the same job hired in December 2025 because parts can now go to Claude while other parts require humans. This creates extra hours in the employee's day for growth opportunities and career augmentation rather than job elimination.

real_qa.q: How can CHROs use Spinach AI for real-time executive coaching and leadership development?
real_qa.r: Spinach AI acts as an AI note taker with a leadership component agent that provides coaching after every one-on-one meeting. It identifies what you did well and development opportunities by comparing what was said by both parties, providing fact-based feedback without bias. You set it up with meeting context and roles, and Spinach keeps track of all meetings to offer coaching based on your communication patterns and organizational knowledge.
real_qa.requete: Spinach AI executive coaching one-on-one meetings

real_qa.q: What are the most essential human elements of HR leadership as AI automation increases?
real_qa.r: With a fully remote company, create a playbook for manager cadence and rhythm with their teams, offering different plays for monthly, weekly, or event-based communication via Teams, email, voice, or video. Include regular fun and non-work moments quarterly, like team tacos and casual conversations unrelated to goals or AI. Keep humanity in the human by designing authentic leadership practices that maintain connection and psychological safety.
real_qa.requete: human connection remote team management HR

real_qa.q: What mid-career skills should professionals prioritize given rapid AI adoption?
real_qa.r: Focus on economic preparation in your 30s and 40s to give yourself optionality and freedom to choose if you hit an inflection point. Take aptitude tests to discover what you're truly good at versus what you've been doing for 20 years; you may excel at something but get no joy from it. Build skills that give you options, and realize that some professionals will lean into AI while others won't—both are valid, but be aware that clients and patients may seek those with advanced AI-enhanced capabilities.

guest.bio_context: Lorna Hagan is the CHRO of Revacore, a cloud-based company with a human-centric business model. She has extensive experience leading organizational transformation through AI integration and workforce design, and is currently undertaking year-long projects to redesign career frameworks and job descriptions across all teams in response to generative AI adoption.
